name: Abstract API
summary: Abstract's IP Intelligence API: location, time zone, currency, ASN and company for an IP, with VPN, proxy, Tor, hosting, relay, mobile and abuse flags.

ip_intelligence_key.description: The API key of Abstract's IP Intelligence API (Abstract dashboard). Each Abstract API has its own key; an email or phone key will not work here. Sent as a Bearer token.

notes: Only the IP Intelligence API is in this entry; Abstract's other APIs each need their own key.
Free plans allow 1 request per second (429 past it) and answer 422 when the credits run out. A 204 means there is no location data for the IP.

endpoints.name: Look up an IP's location and security flags
endpoints.summary: City, region, postal code, country, continent, coordinates, time zone, currency, flag, ASN, company, hosted domains and is_vpn, is_proxy, is_tor, is_hosting, is_relay, is_mobile, is_abuse.

ip_address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address; when left out, the caller's own IP is used.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to return, e.g. location,security.
